D2: Removed `parse_entries`; read a ledger from text with `read_journal` instead, which takes the same arguments (#412).
Removed `Ledger.tally`; use `Ledger.bucketize` with the same `by` argument (#405).
The `start` argument of `Ledger.running_total` has been removed; pass the opening balance as `opening` (#421).
The `thousands` argument of `fmt_amount` has been removed; use `style="grouped"` to add thousands separators (#430).
`merge` has been removed. Use `chain`, which joins any number of ledgers in the order given (#398).
`gridwell.row_means` was removed. Use `gridwell.collapse(g, "mean", axis=1)`, which reduces a grid along either axis with sum, mean, max or min (gh-212).
The `wrap` keyword of `smooth` was removed. Pass `boundary="periodic"` for a periodic grid; the default, `boundary="clip"`, keeps the previous behavior (gh-241).
`gridwell.peak_index` was removed in favor of `gridwell.locate(g, "max")`, which can also find the smallest value (gh-219).
The `reps` keyword of `tile` was replaced by `layout` (gh-244).
`wrap` no longer accepts `width`; the line length is now given as `measure` (#97).
The `strip_accents` argument of `normalize` was replaced by `fold`; `fold="ascii"` removes accents (#102).
`word_count` was removed. The counts of a text are now available from `digest(text)`, whose `words` attribute replaces it (#91).
